page_title: PAR 0-1 REN | Paris FC v Rennes 07/11/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' Guillaume Paradis shows a yellow card to Ilan Kebbal (Paris FC) for his unsportsmanlike behavior after the match has ended.
90+6' The match has just finished.
90+5' Quentin Merlin (Rennes) skips perfectly past challenges but misdirects his shot from the edge of the box. The ball flies a few yards over the bar.
90+4' Otavio (Paris FC) picks up a yellow card.
90+3' A short pass finds Otavio (Paris FC) in acres of space on the edge of the box and he decides to go for glory. His efforts looks in for all the world but just creeps past the left post.
90+2' Anthony Rouault (Rennes) is booked.
90+1' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Przemyslaw Frankowski (Rennes) will replace Mousa Tamari.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
90' Otavio (Paris FC) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
87' Here is a change. Thibault De Smet is going off and Stephane Gilli gives the last tactical orders to Nouha Dicko (Paris FC).
87' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Adama Camara walks off the pitch to be replaced by Vincent Marchetti (Paris FC).
86' A substitution has been made. Pierre Lees-Melou goes off and Tuomas Ollila (Paris FC) comes on.
84' Mathieu Cafaro (Paris FC) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
83' Habib Beye has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Seko Fofana (Rennes) replacing Esteban Lepaul.

81' 0 - 1 A superb goal from great team play! Breel Embolo (Rennes) latches on to a perfect pass and fires an excellent low shot inside the left post. There is nothing a goalkeeper can do about shots like that.
80' Today's match ends for Moses Simon who will be replaced by Mathieu Cafaro (Paris FC).
80' A cross into the box from Moses Simon (Paris FC) is cleared.
79' Maxime Lopez (Paris FC) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
78' Thibault De Smet (Paris FC) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly towards the top left corner, but Brice Samba is well positioned to make a comfortable save.
76' The corner is swung in but Rennes can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
76' A cross from Ilan Kebbal (Paris FC) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
74' This is a yellow card! Mahdi Camara (Rennes) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.
74' Willem Geubbels (Paris FC) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
73' Stephane Gilli decides to make a substitution. Jean-Philippe Krasso will be replaced by Willem Geubbels (Paris FC).
73' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Paris FC comes to nothing.
72' The Rennes players are exchanging some short passes.
71' Paris FC take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
66' A substitution has been made. Djaoui Cisse is replaced by Ludovic Blas (Rennes).
66' Habib Beye has decided to make a change. Breel Embolo (Rennes) replaces Mohamed Meite.
65' Ilan Kebbal (Paris FC) latches onto a pass inside the box, steps inside his marker and smacks a shot against the right post.
63' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Otavio (Paris FC), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
61' Rennes can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
60' Moses Simon (Paris FC) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Brice Samba, who smothers the ball.
59' Neat passing move from Rennes in order to create new attacking opportunities.
57' Thibault De Smet (Paris FC) makes a bad tackle on his opponent and is angry when the referee shows him a deserved yellow card.
56' Quentin Merlin (Rennes) unleashes a shot goalwards from a mid-range free kick. The ball heads towards the right post, but the goalkeeper makes a decent save to thwart him.
55' Rennes take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
54' Guillaume Paradis blows his whistle after Mousa Tamari (Rennes) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
54' Mousa Tamari (Rennes) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
53' Rennes are passing the ball across the pitch and keep possession. However, an opponent intercepts a pass and the situation changes.
51' An attempted cross from Obed Nkambadio (Paris FC) is cleared.
50' Esteban Lepaul (Rennes) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and shoots. His poorly placed shot flies well wide of the right post.
50' The ball is cleared after Moses Simon (Paris FC) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
49' Rennes are playing excellent possession football at the moment by exchanging some long passes.
47' A short pass finds Jean-Philippe Krasso (Paris FC). He spots the keeper off his line and shoots from mid-range, but the ball sails high over the bar.
46' The whistle blows and Guillaume Paradis starts the second half.
45+2' The match has reached half-time.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
45' Mohamed Meite (Rennes) picks up a pass and tries his luck from mid-range towards the left side of the goal, but Obed Nkambadio is equal to it and makes an easy save.
43' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Rennes.
43' Pierre Lees-Melou (Paris FC) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a precise pass. He pulls the trigger but only hits one of the opposition, who gets in the way of his effort.
41' The resulting corner from Mousa Tamari (Rennes) comes to nothing.
41' Mousa Tamari (Rennes) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
40' The resulting set piece from Paris FC is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
40' Paris FC can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
39' Jean-Philippe Krasso (Paris FC) receives a diagonal pass, bursts into the box and shoots towards the bottom right corner. Brice Samba is well positioned, though, and it's a comfortable save.
38' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Anthony Rouault (Rennes).
37' Paris FC hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
36' Mohamed Meite (Rennes) gets in a header from close range after a lofted pass, but the effort flies just over the bar.

35' Brice Samba pulls off a great save to deny Pierre Lees-Melou (Paris FC) after receiving a precise defence-splitting pass. The effort is headed for the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper dives superbly to stop it. Definitely the best save of this match so far!
33' Thibault De Smet (Paris FC) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
33' The corner is swung in but Rennes can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
32' Mamadou Mbow (Paris FC) jumps inside the box to meet the corner and aims a low header towards the left post, but the goalkeeper pulls off an astonishing save to deny him.
32' Maxime Lopez (Paris FC) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
30' Obed Nkambadio steps in and intercepts a long pass from Anthony Rouault (Rennes).
30' Obed Nkambadio (Paris FC) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
27' Rennes are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
25' Djaoui Cisse (Rennes) sends a cross into the box, but Obed Nkambadio comes off his line to gather the ball.
25' A quickly taken corner by Rennes.
24' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Rennes.
24' Ilan Kebbal (Paris FC) smashes an explosive long-range volley towards the roof of the net, but the goalkeeper makes a comfortable save.
20' One of the Rennes players tripped an opponent and conceded a foul.
20' Mousa Tamari (Rennes) sends a chip pass into the box, but Obed Nkambadio is quickest to intercept the ball.
20' 50:50 – the ratio of ball possession.
19' Rennes control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
17' Ilan Kebbal (Paris FC) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
17' Ilan Kebbal (Paris FC) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
15' Great teamplay by Rennes as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
14' Rennes failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
14' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Rennes comes to nothing.
13' Rennes have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
12' Jean-Philippe Krasso (Paris FC) finds himself behind the opposition's defence, but the game is stopped for offside.
11' A pass by Lilian Brassier (Rennes) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
9' Jean-Philippe Krasso (Paris FC) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
7' Djaoui Cisse (Rennes) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Guillaume Paradis no option but to blow his whistle.
7' Mousa Tamari (Rennes) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
5' Rennes string together a series of short passes.
4' Otavio (Paris FC) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. The ball is out of play. Paris FC will take a throw-in.
4' Ilan Kebbal (Paris FC) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Guillaume Paradis blows for a foul.
3' Pierre Lees-Melou (Paris FC) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
1' Obed Nkambadio (Paris FC) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
1' The first half has just begun.
